External-AfterHours-Operator (start approved runbooks only)
NOTE:
Tools only. Roles that reach other accounts are specific and limited, and Production changes need an approver. Pipelines
move code, never data. The provider starts approved runbooks
and never opens a session in Production.

div.span:
1. Restricted staff use the tools; the after-hours provider starts approved runbooks only.
2. Limited, approved roles carry code and runbook steps into other accounts; no data moves and there is no network link
3. Logs go to the Log Archive account, which nobody here can change.
4. Findings and alerts go to the Security / Audit account.

span.span: Production changes need an approver. Pipelines move code, never data.
